timing.definition: Local full-schedule duration, same common initialization and final data readout; not measured server execution timestamps

metadata.measurement_policy: First-round main records only for all r1 arms; auxiliary repeats saved but excluded from decoder
metadata.decoder_policy: All three r1 arms share the same primary one-round DEM; r3 uses its own round-matched DEM. CZ-aware model is saved only for secondary analysis.
metadata.zero_round_policy: Prepare physical data in Z0, no stabilizer extraction, same final logical-Z parity support. No decoder/correction. Not an encoded arbitrary-state quantum memory.
limitations: Full pulse schedule matching assumes identical common initialization and final readout overhead.
Local compiler/controller settings may differ from the historical/server execution configuration.
CZ echo is an identity control with 48 extra CZs, not an unpaired CZ on encoded data.
Primary decoder is fixed across the r1 controls and does not model extra component/padding damage; raw outcomes are also reported.
